prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t objectively name one single “best” lawyer for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on your injuries, the facts, and the lawyer’s experience with similar cases. I can, however, tell you how to quickly find a top Atlanta personal-injury lawyer and what to look for so you pick the best one for your situation.

What to prioritize
- Relevant experience: handled many car-accident cases with similar injuries and liability issues.  
- Trial experience: many cases settle, but you want a lawyer who will actually try the case if needed.  
- Track record: past settlements/verdicts in significant car-accident matters.  
- Resources: firm can advance costs (medical records, expert witnesses) and manage litigation.  
- Communication: clear, timely answers and a single point of contact.  
- Fee structure: contingency fee (no upfront fee; lawyer paid from recovery) and clear breakdown of costs.  
- Reputation: client reviews, peer ratings (Martindale‑Hubbell, Super Lawyers, Avvo), and local bar standing.

Where to search
- Georgia State Bar / Atlanta Bar Association lawyer referral services.  
- Super Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell, Avvo, Google reviews, and “Super Lawyers” lists for Atlanta.  
- Recommendations from doctors, hospital social workers, or people you trust who had similar cases.  
- Georgia Trial Lawyers Association membership indicates focus on plaintiff-side injury work.

Important legal facts
- Statute of limitations in Georgia: generally 2 years from the accident for personal injury (act quickly).  
- Typical contingency fees: often 33%–40% of recovery (ask for the exact percentage and how costs are handled).

What to bring/ask at a consultation
Bring: police report, photos of crash/damage/injuries, medical records and bills, insurance info, witness contacts, correspondence with insurers.
Ask: How many car-accident cases have you handled? What were outcomes? Do you take cases on contingency? Who will handle my case day-to-day? Do you have trial experience? What’s a realistic range of recovery? How long will this take?

Next step
If you want, tell me:
- the ZIP code in Atlanta where you’re located,  
- a brief summary of injuries/property damage, and  
- whether you’ve already talked to your insurer or the other party’s insurer.

I can then give a targeted list of well-rated Atlanta personal-injury firms/attorneys and sample questions to use in consultations.
